title: CYBRIK org scope grant v1 (D-4, D-7)
description: The hierarchical authorization object that encodes INV-1 in the schema (ADR-0007 D-4; 02 §2.2). scope_kind selects reach; subject_relationship is the INV-1 hinge. raw_scope and aggregate_scope are DISJOINT: an ancestor's default cross-tier reach ('ancestor-governance') carries GOVERNANCE ONLY (aggregate, never automatic raw); raw descendant access requires an 'explicit-descendant-grant' with a NON-EMPTY raw_scope + need-to-know (a missing/empty raw scope denies, never fail-opens). An 'aggregate' grant may NEVER carry raw_scope. mechanism='break-glass' is the loud, self-revoking OD-6 emergency path (read-only default, 15-min default / 60-min max requiring a second approval, mandatory oversight + high-severity audit). tenant/RBAC/RLS remain AND-composed with this grant at runtime. $id uses the RFC 2606 .example documentation domain. Status: ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION (v0.1.0; not stable v1/GA). Accepted at Gate W2-G (Codex under Founder delegation, 2026-07-24).

grant_id.description: Opaque grant id. Revocation targets this id.

tenant_id.description: The tenant this grant is evaluated in. MUST equal subject.tenant_id and target_node.tenant_binding (cross-tenant grants are rejected at runtime; OD-1). AND-composed with tenant isolation + RBAC + RLS.

grantor.description: Who issued the grant. Under separation_of_duties MUST be distinct from subject (runtime).

target_node.description: The node / subtree this grant reaches. A relying party MUST verify the subject's tree relationship to this node matches subject_relationship (a sibling or unrelated node is not a valid descendant/own target).

raw_scope.description: Explicit raw-record reach. Present ONLY for own-node / explicit-descendant-grant / delegated-object. patterns is NON-EMPTY (minItems 1): a missing/empty raw scope denies (fail-closed), it never means grant-all. need_to_know is the object-level predicate (INV-1; 02 §2.5).

patterns.description: Explicit resource patterns the raw grant covers (e.g. named cases/assets). Non-empty by construction.

aggregate_scope.description: De-identified aggregate reach over the subtree — the default cross-tier visibility. Carries NO raw records and NO objectRef: only dimensions + the small-cell floor. Disjoint from raw_scope.

dimensions.description: The metric dimensions rolled up (e.g. 'severity', 'category'). No raw identifiers.

break_glass.description: Required when mechanism='break-glass' (ADR-0007 OD-6). Fires only from a declared scenario; loud, self-revoking, after-action-reviewed. Default read-only; up to 3600s but any duration over the 900s default requires a second human approval. Never granted write/action authority by break-glass alone.

scenario.description: The declared break-glass scenario from the catalog (OD-6). Free-form break-glass is not permitted operationally.

access_mode.description: Default 'read-only' (OD-6). 'write' remains risk-class approval gated and is NEVER granted by break-glass alone; a relying party MUST additionally enforce that gate.

max_duration_seconds.description: Self-revoke ceiling. Default 900 (15 min); maximum 3600 (60 min). Any value over 900 requires second_approval (OD-6).

oversight_notification.description: Const true: break-glass is loud — the owning node and oversight are notified (OD-6).

high_severity_audit.description: Const true: a high-severity audit event is raised (OD-6).

after_action_review.description: Const true: an after-action review is mandated (OD-6).

second_approval.description: A second distinct human approval, REQUIRED when max_duration_seconds > 900 (OD-6).

approver.description: The second approver MUST be a human (type='user').

allOf.$comment: OD-6: a break-glass over the 15-minute default requires a second human approval.

temporal.description: Expiry + revocation envelope. audit_ref is required for any grant reaching raw data (runtime).

allOf.$comment: INV-1: an ancestor's default cross-tier reach is GOVERNANCE ONLY — aggregate, never automatic raw. ancestor-governance forbids raw_scope and forces aggregate.
aggregate scope carries NO raw records: raw_scope is forbidden and aggregate_scope required.
INV-1 raw descendant access requires an EXPLICIT descendant grant + a non-empty raw_scope (empty scope denies, never fail-opens).
own-node raw is permitted within tenant + need-to-know.
delegated reaches only the specific delegated object, time-boxed.
break-glass mechanism requires the break_glass oversight block.
